# FixedSubspace { #deep_tensor.FixedSubspace }

```python
FixedSubspace(
    basis: Tensor,
    num_comp: int = 0,
    fixed_comp: bool = True,
    device: torch.device = torch.get_default_device(),
)
```

A fixed subspace.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**basis**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Tensor]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The basis for the subspace.

<code>[**num_comp**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   The number of samples from the complement subspace to use when  evaluating the profile function.

<code>[**fixed_comp**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Whether to fix the samples from the complement subspace.

<code>[**device**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [torch.device]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [torch.get_default_device()]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   The device to carry out computations on.
